Asgardians

By: Michael Duffett | Delivery

Proposal


Show:

Unique Selling Point:
An entertaining story which will illicit lots of comments. The setting up of a new Kingdom is space - spearheaded by a Russian businessman. The kingdom has been set up to safe space, for settlement and for inhabitation of the moon. Already its pariament has been chosen and convened in Vienna last year snd its first satellite sent into space. There are over a million members to this new kingdom and of course the major thrust is to try and get it recognised by the UN. A major selling point is that there is a South African who is on the parliament and the 2nd most important person of the kingdom, the head of parliament, an ex UYK MP is in South Africa to promote the kingdom and also to garnish support from the wc. govt. Despuite cynicism, there are a lot of scientific supports. see email

Summary:
The story starts with the talk given at UCT and a description of what Asagarida is all about. We need to cover areas like - who actually owns space. What laws are in place at present. People may think its all a bit loopy, but the fact is that a parliament had already been formed, and there are lots of backers gives the story credibility. We will have access to video material as well as nassar footage. We want to film presenter against a green background to super impose her on space shots!

Further information:
One filming day ... long....friday.
To interview:
head of parliament
SA member of parliament
African parliament member from up north.
A scientist from Cspe Town
Student expert in space law.

Script:


script

In November last year a satellite called Asgardia 1, was launched and blasted into space by the worlds first self proclaimed space nation - The Kingdom of ASGARDIA: A small satellite, the size of a loaf of bread is orbiting earth carrying data belonging to Asgardians, as well as the the space nations flag and constitution.

LINK: The space kingdom of Asgardia might sound like the title to a science fiction movie, some critics dismiss it as a joke, but for a number of serious scientists, lawyers and space explorers, Asgardia is a legitimate venture to investigate how human life may be conducted in space

The self appointed founding father of the Asgardian kingdom is Award winning Russian billionaire and scientist Dr. Igor Ashurbeyli who has always dreamt of a space nation

Dr. Igor Ashurbeyli ; So this is the future of mankind…abandonment from our cradle, from our planet into space

Dr Ashebeyli, who is also The founder of the aerospace international research center in Vienna chose the name Asgardia which has its origins in Norse mythology. – His ambition - to ensure the peaceful use of space, protect the earth from space hazards and create a demilitarized and free scientific base. Long term objectives – habitual platforms in outer space and settlements on the moon.

And judging from his glittering inauguration as the first head of state in Vienne in June which was attended by a host of dignitaries from around the world, Asgardians are not joking!

Ben Dell: We are trying to build a new nation from scratch, its never been done before
One of our very own Benn Dell was in Vienna when Asgardia’s first parliament was elected. Ben, who has a back round in electronics, lives in the small, town of Heidleberg in the Western cape town. His interest was piqued when he came across across the Asgardian website last year

Ben Dell. And I thought that this was a cuckoo idea. And then I looked at the people who were involved in it, I am talking about people from the Rice institute, and people involved in the ISS project, and if these people are involved, then perhaps there is more to what I am seeing on the surface.

Benn applied to become a parliamentarian and was voted in!

Ben Dell: I think that there were over 1000 people that applied and I came in at number 34 in the amount of votes that were cast world wide and yes that is where I am today,

Presenter: That must have been an amazing feeling.

Ben Dell: it was fantastic, and I never thought that the people would read my platform and people agreed to it, its fantastic.

Around the world there more than 272000 residents of this kingdom and over a million followers and they all joined via the internet! . In South Africa there are 1035 full residents. Ben recently travelled to Cape town to join fellow Asgardian Lembit Opek, the chairman of its parliament. They were in town to drum up support .. Lembit, who is a former member of the British parliament is used to eye brows being raised about the kingdom!

Presenter – how has the response been?

Lembit Opek: People ask the same questions as you…. Is this real, is it a cult, are you going to go into space, and these are perfectly legitimate questions, do I look like a cult, how ordinary could I look, I even have grey hair, then there are those who say this is not credible, it cant work, and then the third group who say, well we will reserve judgment and see what you doing.

There are other ambitious space projects taking part in the space race….South African born Elon Musk founder of space X is working towards settlements on Mars, and the richest man on earth Geoff Bizoz founder of blue orizon is gearing up towards commercial space travel. Asgardia goes a step further: it’s the first legitimate attempt create an independent nation in space. At this stage though, their only real estate is the hard drive circling earth! Big question – cost? The international space station so far has gobbled up150 billion dollars and who knows how much that first space ark set for 25 years time will cost!!!

Link
70 years ago if I had to tell a scientist that we would eventually be able to fit a computer into our pockets, which was then the size of a house, into our pockets, they would not believe me,. So who is to say what will happen in the next 30 to 50 years at the rate technology is advancing


Carla Sharpe seen here at the recent international astronomical congress in Germany is an expert in African space policy and strategy. She is determined that space race competition and technological advances will bring prices down .One of the tricks is not to incur huge expenses by hauling up goods into space.

Carla Sharpe : if we could 3d print space craft in space, we would not have to transport stuff into space, this would make it much cheaper and easier.

And that includes ferrying up into the space the vital source of life – Water!
Carla Sharpe “ if we were able to obtain water from asteroid mining in space we would not have to transport it up – that would reduce costs.

At this stage Dr Asherbeyli is funding Asgardia but the kingdom plans to have its own cryptocurrencty and will be releasing its business plans at the end of the year. Another massive hurdle is to persuade the UN to change space laws. At this stage an outer space treaty prohibits sovereignty in outer space.

Lembit Opek: If we have got that Un recognition, we would be bringing something to the table as well….because that is our prime focus, there is no other nation on the planet…which is designed for what we think is humanities’ space destiny……it’s a really big thing….every time I say it my heart goes faster!!


Ben Bell and Lemit Opek as well as cape town Agardians are confident that the kingdom can rise up to the challenges, and that includes NKULULEKO NTSUKWANA

NKULULEKO NTSUKWANA honestly the future for humans is not only on earth, there are boundless limits out there, and asgardia is the first step.

Carla Sharpe: Asgardia’s plans do look ambitious. But I think, whether they achieve it or not, it echoes the passions that all of us in space are hoping to fruition, and imagine colonies living in space, would it not be wonderful, and if they are a step towards that, and helping the process and awareness,, then its wonderful.


The constitution guarantees the freedom of all citizens, and this is important for all Asgaridan members who hail from countries where human rights are trampled upon.

Lembit Opek: its got to be a role model for how nations here on earth behave…and if we do that right, maybe terrestrial nations can learn from us.“

And Ben can’t contain his excitement about out this utopian ideal, especially as he was also voted in as chairman of the asgardian citizen committee – a position he attributes to SA’s widely respected constitution.

Ben Dell:“ If we are going to work for the future of humanity, then I have to work from the best, that is why i am chairman of the citizens committee, because I believe that we can do a nation here which will benefit future humanity for all times to come.
